mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wishlists (id, user_id, hotel_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{hotelId}, now())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wishlists WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT h.id AS id, h.name AS name, h.address AS address, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(rv.rating) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.hotel_id = h.id), 0) AS rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews rv WHERE rv.hotel_id = h.id) AS review_count, (SELECT MIN(r.price_per_night) FROM rooms r WHERE r.hotel_id = h.id AND r.status = 'SALE') AS price_per_night, (SELECT hi.image_url FROM hotel_images hi WHERE hi.hotel_id = h.id ORDER BY hi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image FROM wishlists w JOIN hotels h ON h.id = w.hotel_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
